storiesThatMove.name: Nassos Ghavelas
storiesThatMove.quote: In elite sport, it’s the small details that make the difference. What I appreciate about SPOTTEQ is that it doesn’t promise miracles; it delivers clean, targeted formulas and I know exactly what they do to my body. For me, performance is not just about times and records, but about feeling safe and confident in every training session and every race.

featuredProducts.description: A focused line of science-driven formulas for strength, performance, recovery and everyday health. Explore all our series, flavours and formats to build the system that works for your body and training.

bundles.description: Curated combinations of products that work together – for strength, performance, recovery and everyday health. Choose a Performance or Clinical bundle to simplify your routine and get a complete SPOTTEQ system in just one step.

about.description: SPOTTEQ is a performance nutrition brand created for athletes who care about what goes into their body. Each formula is science-driven, clean and clearly labelled, and part of a small, carefully curated line of products designed to support strength, recovery and everyday health in one focused system – like a trusted spotter that’s always there, even when no one else is.

quality.description: The core principle of SPOTTEQ is to offer premium products, providing a reliable and transparent choice for every athlete. With an emphasis on high bioavailability, easy digestion, and exceptional taste, our products are manufactured under strict international quality standards and are notified to the EOF (National Organization for Medicines), ensuring premium quality and safe consumption.
